sections.title: 1. Acceptance of the Terms
paragraphs: Welcome to EduAirControl. These Terms and Conditions establish the rules for accessing and using the platform.
By registering, accessing, or using EduAirControl, you declare that you have read and understood these terms and agree to comply with the provisions set forth herein.
Where applicable, the processing of personal data will also be subject to EduAirControl's Personal Data Processing Policy and the applicable Colombian regulations.

sections.title: 2. User Registration and Responsibility
paragraphs: The information provided during registration must be truthful, complete, up to date, and verifiable.
Each user is responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of their access credentials and for the activities carried out through their account.
The user must promptly report any unauthorized access, loss of credentials, or situation that may compromise the security of their account.

sections.title: 3. Permitted Use of the Platform
paragraphs: EduAirControl must be used exclusively for educational, administrative, and environmental monitoring purposes authorized by the institution.
The user agrees to use the platform responsibly and in accordance with applicable Colombian legislation.
list: Attempting to access EduAirControl accounts, systems, databases, or services without authorization.
Manipulating, altering, deleting, or extracting information without authorization.
Interfering with the operation of the platform or connected IoT devices.
Exploiting security vulnerabilities to obtain unauthorized access.
Using the platform for illegal activities or activities contrary to these terms.
sections.note: Unauthorized access to computer systems or breaches of data may result in the corresponding legal consequences under Colombian legislation.

sections.title: 4. Information Obtained Through IoT Sensors
paragraphs: EduAirControl may collect and display environmental information from IoT devices, including variables such as temperature, humidity, CO₂ concentration, and noise levels, according to the sensors implemented in each environment.
This information is intended for monitoring, analysis, and decision-making support regarding the environmental conditions of educational spaces.
Data obtained through sensors may present variations, measurement errors, or interruptions resulting from device operation, communications, or external factors.
The information provided by the platform does not replace inspections, measurements, or specialized technical assessments when necessary.

sections.title: 5. Personal Data Protection
paragraphs: EduAirControl will process personal data in accordance with the principles and obligations established by applicable Colombian regulations, particularly Law 1581 of 2012 and its implementing regulations.
Personal data will be processed for legitimate, informed purposes related to the provision and administration of the platform's services.
When necessary, processing will be supported by the prior, express, and informed authorization of the data subject, in accordance with applicable legislation.
Data subjects may exercise their rights to know, update, and rectify their data, request information about its processing, and submit inquiries or complaints to the data controller or processor.
Specific conditions regarding the collection, storage, use, circulation, retention, and deletion of data are established in EduAirControl's Personal Data Processing Policy.

sections.title: 6. Information Security
paragraphs: EduAirControl will implement reasonable technical, administrative, and organizational measures intended to protect information against unauthorized access, loss, alteration, disclosure, or misuse.
However, no computer system can guarantee absolute security against all technological risks, external incidents, or circumstances beyond the platform's reasonable control.
Users must also adopt reasonable measures to protect their accounts and access credentials.

sections.title: 7. Availability and Updates
paragraphs: EduAirControl may experience temporary interruptions due to maintenance, updates, technical failures, connectivity issues, IoT device operation, or other technical circumstances.
The platform may receive updates, improvements, modifications, or corrections intended to improve its operation, security, and quality.
When necessary, relevant modifications will be communicated through the channels available on the platform or through the means established by the institution.

sections.title: 8. Accuracy of Information
paragraphs: EduAirControl will endeavor to provide clear and reliable information within the technical capabilities of the platform.
However, data obtained from sensors may be subject to variations, measurement errors, connectivity failures, or limitations inherent to the devices used.
Decisions requiring specialized technical assessment should be supported by the corresponding procedures and verifications.

sections.title: 9. Modifications to the Terms and Conditions
paragraphs: EduAirControl may modify these Terms and Conditions when necessary due to functional, technical, legal, or administrative changes.
Modifications will be published or communicated through the mechanisms available on the platform.
When required by applicable regulations, the user's acceptance will be requested again.

sections.title: 10. Non-Compliance
paragraphs: Failure to comply with these Terms and Conditions may result in the suspension or restriction of access to the platform, in accordance with the institution's policies and without prejudice to any legal actions that may apply.

sections.title: 11. Applicable Law
paragraphs: These Terms and Conditions shall be interpreted in accordance with applicable Colombian legislation.

Regarding personal data protection, applicable provisions shall be taken into account, including Article 15 of the Political Constitution of Colombia, Law 1581 of 2012, and its implementing regulations.
Provisions related to computer crimes shall apply where appropriate, including the conduct established under Law 1273 of 2009.

sections.title: 12. Acceptance
paragraphs: By selecting “Accept”, the user confirms that they have read, understood, and accepted these Terms and Conditions of Use.
Where applicable to the processing of personal data, acceptance of these terms does not replace the specific authorization that may be required under personal data protection regulations.

terms.intro: By accessing and using EduAirControl, you agree to comply with the following terms and conditions of use:

sections.title: Acceptance of terms
items: By creating an account or using the platform, you confirm that you accept these terms in full.
If you do not agree with any part of them, you should refrain from using EduAirControl.

sections.title: Your account
items: You must provide accurate, complete and up-to-date information when registering.
You are responsible for keeping your password confidential and for all activity carried out from your account.
Notify us immediately if you suspect unauthorized use of your account.

sections.title: Permitted use of the platform
items: The platform must be used only for authorized, educational and lawful purposes.
You may not attempt to breach, overload or interfere with the sensors, servers or operation of the system.
You may not copy, resell or redistribute the service without prior authorization.

sections.title: Environmental data and reports
items: Environmental data (air quality, temperature, humidity, etc.) is provided for monitoring and informational purposes only.
It should not be used as the sole source for critical safety decisions; always follow your institution’s official protocols in an emergency.

sections.title: Intellectual property
items: The EduAirControl name, logo, design and software are owned by their creators and protected by copyright.
No right to use these marks outside the platform is granted without express authorization.

sections.title: Suspension and cancellation
items: We may suspend or cancel accounts that violate these terms or pose a risk to the platform or other users.
You can request deletion of your account at any time from the Privacy section.

sections.title: Changes to these terms
items: We may update these terms periodically to reflect improvements or legal changes.
Continued use of the platform after an update means you accept the changes.

terms.footer: Questions about these terms? Write to us at support@eduaircontrol.com.

privacyModal.intro: At EduAirControl we take the protection of your personal information seriously. This policy explains what data we collect and how we protect it:

sections.title: What information we collect
items: Account data: name, email address and login credentials.
Environmental data generated by your institution’s sensors (air quality, temperature, humidity, etc.).
Usage data: preferences, language, time zone and app settings.

sections.title: How we use your information
items: To give you access to the dashboard, rankings and platform notifications.
To generate environmental reports for your institution.
To improve the service and contact you about important updates.

sections.title: How we protect your data
items: Your data is transmitted and stored encrypted.
Passwords are never stored in plain text; they are protected with secure hashing algorithms.
Access to information is restricted to authorized staff who need it to operate the platform.
We regularly review our security practices to prevent unauthorized access.

sections.title: Who we share your information with
items: We do not sell or rent your personal data to third parties.
We only share information with administrators of your own institution, or with providers strictly necessary to operate the service (for example, hosting).
We may disclose information if required by law.

sections.title: Your rights
items: You can access, correct or update your personal data from your profile.
You can request deletion of your account and data at any time from this Settings section.
You can request a copy of the information we hold about you by contacting support.

sections.title: Data retention
items: We keep your information while your account is active.
When you request account deletion, your personal data is deleted or anonymized within a reasonable period, unless the law requires us to retain it.

privacyModal.footer: Questions about how we handle your data? Write to us at support@eduaircontrol.com.

hero.badge: Leading platform in educational environmental monitoring
hero.description: Monitor air quality in classrooms, labs and educational spaces in real time using IoT sensors, intelligent analysis and automatic alerts.

why.title: Everything you need to
why.description: EduAirControl integrates IoT sensors, intelligent analysis and real-time visualization to keep spaces healthy and safe.
why.card1Desc: Captures environmental data in real time from multiple devices.
why.card2Desc: Automatically detects risks and notifies before they become a problem.
why.card3Desc: Visualize indicators, charts and historical data from anywhere.
why.card4Desc: Helps improve air quality and the well-being of students and teachers.

modules.title: System
modules.description: EduAirControl integrates all the tools needed to monitor, analyze and manage air quality in educational institutions from a single place.
modules.module1Desc: Automatic notifications when air quality exceeds safe limits.
modules.module2Desc: Historical reports with environmental charts and statistics.
modules.module3Desc: Manage administrators, teachers and students from a single platform.
modules.module4Desc: Connect and monitor all devices responsible for measuring air quality.

howItWorks.title: How does
howItWorks.description: From data capture to metric visualization and alert generation, all information flows automatically through a modern, secure and scalable architecture.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Capture temperature, humidity, CO₂ and PM2.5 particles in real time.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Receives and transmits information generated by the devices.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Processes readings, applies business rules and analyzes risks.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Stores historical data, metrics and environmental records.
howItWorks.step5Desc: Visualizes indicators, charts and the status of each classroom.
howItWorks.step6Desc: Generates automatic notifications when a risk exists.
howItWorks.systemOkDesc: All sensors are reporting data. No environmental risks detected.

technologies.title: Technologies behind
technologies.description: We use modern tools to build a scalable, secure platform ready for IoT applications.
technologies.tech1Desc: Modern, fast and fully responsive interface.
technologies.tech3Desc: Efficient persistence for large volumes of data.

designedFor.title: Designed for
designedFor.description: EduAirControl offers specific tools for each profile, enabling efficient environmental management within educational institutions.
designedFor.user1Desc: Manage the entire platform, oversee campuses, review environmental metrics and generate strategic reports.
designedFor.user2Desc: View the environmental status of their classrooms and receive alerts to act quickly.
designedFor.user3Desc: Check air quality indicators and promote healthy habits within the institution.
designedFor.user4Desc: Monitor sensors, perform preventive maintenance and ensure the system is running.

cta.title: Let's build
cta.description: EduAirControl helps monitor air quality in real time, generate smart alerts and make data-driven decisions to protect the entire educational community.

footer.description: Intelligent platform for real-time environmental monitoring, helping educational institutions make better decisions through reliable data.

tooltips.close: Close this window and return to the environment list.
